about: The ten Studio Kit hooks and the events they run on. install.mjs writes these into your Claude Code settings with absolute paths for this machine.

hooks.name: words-guard
hooks.what: Blocks phrases your business never writes (bannedPhrases).

hooks.name: secrets-guard
hooks.what: Blocks live keys written into files.

hooks.name: cron-guard
hooks.what: Blocks two scheduled jobs on the same minute.

hooks.name: git-guard
hooks.what: Blocks force pushes, protected branch deletes and skipped checks. Asks before hard resets.

hooks.name: delete-guard
hooks.what: Blocks recursive deletes outside the workspace.

hooks.name: send-guard
hooks.what: Asks before anything is emailed, texted or posted.

hooks.name: money-guard
hooks.what: Asks before charges, refunds, payouts and price changes.

hooks.name: deploy-guard
hooks.what: Blocks hand-pointed domains. Asks before production deploys.

hooks.name: sql-guard
hooks.what: Asks before drops, truncates and unscoped deletes or updates.

hooks.name: audit-log
hooks.what: Writes every tool call to a monthly audit trail. Never blocks.
